gizmo.title: Nazarin karatu
gizmo.description: Ɗalibai suna sanya tutoci a kan jumloli, sakin layi ko hotuna a cikin karatu waɗanda shaida ne ga kowace lakabi, ko su zaɓi sashen da ya fi amsa tambaya.

configure.title: Tambaya
configure.description: Abin da ake tambayar ɗalibai su nemo a cikin karatun.

configure.title: Aiki
configure.description: Sanya tuta a shaida: ɗalibai suna manna kowace tuta kusa da shaidarta. Zaɓi ɗaya: ɗalibai suna zaɓar sashe guda da ya fi amsa tambayar.

configure.title: Ɗalibai suna zaɓa
configure.description: Abin da ɗalibi ke nunawa a cikin karatun. Ana iya zaɓar hotuna koyaushe.

configure.title: Tutoci
configure.description: Lakabobin da ɗalibai ke sanyawa. Yi amfani da Yi alamar amsoshi a menu na bulo don zaɓar inda kowanne ya dace.

configure.title: Karatu
configure.description: Karatun da ɗalibai ke aiki a ciki. Kowane HTML: kanun labarai, sakin layi, jeri da hotuna.

advanced.title: Ƙoƙari
advanced.description: Sau nawa ɗalibi zai iya dubawa. 0 yana nufin mara iyaka.

advanced.title: Mai naɗewa
advanced.description: Nuna wannan tambayar a matsayin layi da ke buɗewa da rufewa. Buɗe ɗaya yana rufe sauran tambayoyin masu naɗewa da ke kusa da ita.

advanced.title: Fara a naɗe
advanced.description: Idan mai naɗewa ne, zai fara a matsayin layi rufaffe da ke nuna tambayar da matsayinta kawai.

advanced.title: Tsarin maki
advanced.description: OER Schema: tsarin maki na wannan tantancewa (misali maki, harafi, kashi, kammalawa).

advanced.title: Manufar koyo
advanced.description: OER Schema: manufar koyo da ke da alaƙa da wannan tantancewa.

developer.title: Sunan jarrabawa
developer.description: Sunan jarrabawa da ake turawa don amfani a muhallin xAPI don gano wannan abu

developer.title: Kwas
developer.description: OER Schema: kwas ɗin da aka yi wannan tantancewa domin sa.
